item.title: LOT-115: Forum search screen
item.body:
LOT-115
Closes #206
Claim: cloud/lot-115

## Problem
The Plus entry "Rechercher sur le forum" was a placeholder. LOT-046 gave the engine flow, no screen.

## What changed
- `ForumSearchModel` (`@Observable @MainActor`) over a `ForumSearchSource` (live: `GlobalSearchFlow`, network path unchanged): form, banned-word refusal before any request (Q-7), period as start date, paging by pager paths (first / previous / next / last), Annuler, retry, result opened in the reader at the matching message, category stored in `recherche_categorie` and sent only once the forum list vouches for it (Apple category hidden, Q-7).
- `ForumSearchView` and the wiring in `PlusEntryView` / `RootModel.search` (kept across layout changes); `ContentLoader.reset()`.
- Spec `docs/lots/LOT-115-forum-search-screen.md` (legacy counterpart, differences, pending captures), CHANGELOG-LEGACY row 72.
- No engine change, no new dependency.

## Tests
`App/SwiftHFRTests/Search/ForumSearchModelTests.swift` (19 tests), `ContentLoaderTests.resetForgetsTheValueAndTheError`, `RootModelTests` updated (search is built). SwiftLint `--strict` clean locally. The app cannot be built in the cloud: CI is the arbiter. Not shown failing without the change on a Mac (cloud only).

## Review
Adversarial review by Opus, 3 rounds: R1 REQUEST CHANGES (7 findings, fixed), R2 REQUEST CHANGES (test compile error + 3 minor, fixed), R3 APPROVE on 43b9edb (two low notes: first-page button disabled without link, folded in; the saved Discussions fallback of `setCategories` left as is, Q-7).

## Mac check needed
For `mac/m2-lead`:
- [ ] Plus > "Rechercher sur le forum" opens the screen on iPhone and iPad (sidebar); form and results survive a Slide Over / Split View change.
- [ ] A search with accents ("pâtes à l'ail") returns results; one with "jailbreak" shows the warning and sends no request (proxy / log).
- [ ] Words under 4 letters: hint shown, search still runs (what HFR does with them is unsettled, B3).
- [ ] Pager: next / previous / first / last on a multi-page search (pages after the first are not captured, LOT-046).
- [ ] Tap a result: the reader opens at the matching message (`SearchHit.postPath`).
- [ ] Logged out and as the review account: the Apple category is not in the picker.
- [ ] Light, dark, Dynamic Type XL; "Annuler" during a search.
- [ ] `xcodebuild test` on iPhone 18 Pro and an iPad simulator (iOS 27.0); run the new tests against a reverted change to confirm they fail.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added a forum search screen with controls for category, matching words, search scope, and time period.
  * Search results can be opened as topics, browsed across pages, and retried after a failed load.
  * Blank or banned-word searches are not submitted; short-word searches display a helpful notice.
  * Starting a new search clears previous results, while paging failures retain results for retry.
  * The selected search category is remembered and restored when available.

comments.body:
Walkthrough

This PR adds a forum search model and live search source, then connects a search screen to root navigation. The screen supports query and category controls, results, and paging. The changes also add `ContentLoader.reset()` and update search tests and documentation. **Changes: Forum Search** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Search query and result model**
`App/SwiftHFR/Search/ForumSearchModel.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Search/ForumSearchSource.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Navigation/ContentLoader.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Search/*`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/ContentLoaderTests.swift`|The model handles query validation, category selection, date ranges, result reading, paging, retry, and cancellation. The live source calls `GlobalSearchFlow`. `ContentLoader.reset()` cancels loading and clears its value and error. Tests cover these behaviors.| |**Search screen and app wiring**
`App/SwiftHFR/Search/ForumSearchView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Root/*`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Root/RootModelTests.swift`, `docs/CHANGELOG-LEGACY.md`, `docs/lots/LOT-115-forum-search-screen.md`|The screen displays search controls, results, loading and error states, and page controls. Root wiring passes the search model and environment to the Plus entry. Search is marked built. The LOT-115 specification and legacy changelog are updated.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~25 minutes **Change:** Feature ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant ForumSearchView participant ForumSearchModel participant LiveForumSearchSource participant GlobalSearchFlow ForumSearchView->>ForumSearchModel: submit search ForumSearchModel->>LiveForumSearchSource: request initial page LiveForumSearchSource->>GlobalSearchFlow: search with query and session token GlobalSearchFlow-->>LiveForumSearchSource: return search results page LiveForumSearchSource-->>ForumSearchModel: return TopicListPage ForumSearchModel-->>ForumSearchView: display results and paging state ``` **Possibly related PRs** - [ezzz/HFRnow#32](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/32): Adds `ContentLoader` and the forum list used to populate search categories. - [ezzz/HFRnow#303](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/303): Adds Plus navigation and the search placeholder that this PR replaces with the search screen. - [ezzz/HFRnow#33](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/33): Supplies the session used by search requests and their `hash_check` token. **Suggested labels:** `type: lot`
Merge Risk: Moderate · up to 788bb

Author filtering is unavailable, and Apple remains selectable for ordinary signed-in users. Address the required search behavior before merging.
Security architecture risk: Low · up to 788bb

The new search screen sends queries and, when available, an account token to the forum. Requests retain cookie isolation, destination restrictions, and stale-result protections. Live token and pagination behavior remain unconfirmed, and pending searches are not explicitly cancelled when accounts change. No authorization bypass or cross-account disclosure was established. **Retained concerns** No architecture-level concerns identified.
Security review details

**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The newly reachable sensitive data is the user's query and the captured session's hash_check value, sent to the existing forum search endpoint. Search requests do not carry account cookies. Explicitly opening a result enters the existing authenticated topic reader; search-result fetching itself does not use that reader session transport. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — The token-bearing POST does not follow redirects. Result destinations are checked as HTTPS forum pages, and pager requests additionally require /forum1.php with recherches=1. Results GETs also reject redirects. Reader links are parsed into typed topic targets and requests are reconstructed from topic identifiers instead of fetching arbitrary result URLs with credentials. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _inferred_ — Account-session replacement rebuilds the navigation with a separate root, containing old search state rather than transferring it to the new account. However, root disappearance cancels filtering only, while search runs in an independently owned task. A pending search can therefore outlive account switching or removal. The flow is bounded to the submitted search and results fetch, with no automatic retry; cross-account result disclosure was not established. **Hardening Proposals** - _proposed_ — Bind pending search cancellation to account-session replacement or root teardown, while preserving intentional state across layout changes. This would tighten the lifetime of operations retaining a former account's token without treating ordinary search-screen navigation as account revocation. - _proposed_ — Validate the documented external assumptions with cookie-less search exchanges using both empty and account tokens, plus a subsequent results page. Until then, do not treat token acceptance or pagination identity semantics as demonstrated authorization guarantees.
